prompts: A patient brought lab exam PDFs from two different labs, months apart; they are in {WS}/exams. Build one history per marker, every value in the units of the first report, and say what got worse. Record in {WS}/result.json: history (marker -> {date: value}) and worse (a list of the markers that got worse and are now outside the first report's reference range).
answers:
[goal] Build one marker history from two PDFs, first-report units, flag markers worse and outside first-report reference range.
[action] Extracted both PDFs with pdftotext; converted Beta (mmol/L, µmol/L, mmol/mol) to Alfa units (mg/dL, mg/dL, mg/dL, %) and wrote ./result.json.
[result] history: Glicose em jejum 92→109.8 mg/dL; Colesterol LDL 118→143.1 mg/dL; Creatinina 0.95→0.86 mg/dL; HbA1c 5.4→5.5 %. worse (now outside first-report range): Glicose em jejum (ref 70-99), Colesterol LDL (ref <130). Creatinina (0.70-1.30) and HbA1c (4.0-5.6) remain in range; HbA1c rose slightly but stays inside the range, so it is not listed.
[next] Approval/doctor review; noted assumptions below.

"Worse" = higher than first report and now outside the first report's reference range; only markers with a higher-is-worse direction are judged. Marker names and ranges taken from the first (Alfa) report; HbA1c conversion is approximate (IFCC↔NGSP formula).
